summary: Our most specified baths — now with more choice than ever. From compact ensuites to statement master bathrooms, these Studio Bagno favourites continue to define bathroom design across the country.⁠
title: The Baths Designers Keep Coming Back To
bodyHtml:
Meet our Best Selling Baths

From compact footprints to statement forms, our most-specified baths continue to evolve — now offering greater flexibility for a wider range of projects.

Discover how scale, detail, and sculptural form come together in three of Studio Bagno’s most popular bath designs.

See our Bath Collection


The Nur Freestanding Bath - 1600 x 800 x 550 mm - Made from MarmoTech

The Vita Series

The timeless pill shape reimagined — now available in both 1500mm and 1700mm lengths. With its integrated overflow, soft tapering and generous curves, Vita brings a refined sense of balance as a hero piece in your bathroom.

The Nur Bath

Defined by its inverted exterior curves and signature hidden underskirt, the Nur Bath extends the distinctive aesthetic of the entire Nur range into a sculptural, standalone form.

Available in gloss white and semi-gloss white, the subtle detailing and elegant proportions create a floating effect that feels weightless and grounded all at once.

The Lust Series

Now available in a compact 1500mm version, the Lust Wall-Faced Bath brings its signature elegance to both large and smaller spaces.

Its integrated overflow and rear shelf adds utility without sacrificing form. Also available in its original freestanding style (no overflow) and multiple finishes, Lust offers a clean-lined, architectural solution with enduring appeal.
